# sink_scourer — repaired realism QA

- Flattened and irregularized the pad and replaced the dominant smooth core surface with denser visible wire curls.
- Replaced oversized capsule with two core-following convex pieces.
- Declared porous deformable network and retained rigid fallback.

Irregular porous steel-wire pad with synthesized curls and two core-following convex fallback pieces. Fitted bottom z=0.8302 m; floor contact and silhouette remain uncertain near the basin rim. Deformation law/mesh is tentative; rigid fallback does not catch individual wires or compress.

Deformable behavior is required; tentative parameters are declared. The exported Blender runtime still uses the rigid proxy until a simulator soft-body adapter is supplied.

No manipulation was observed. Joints and ranges remain unverified assumptions. See ../qa_report.json and ../qa_summary.md for measured comparisons and outstanding limitations.
